book.name: Lɛme
book.title: Ŋwa wu Lɛme chi booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso

content: Bita sɛɛŋ fiɛɛ fì gɛ̀ kooshɛ a Konɛyu yeh
Booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso mo bamii ba mbɛmɛ ba Judia bachii gɛ̀ yu lɛ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ le bo fi wa tɛ jɛ yi Nyo.
Bita gɛ̀ doo wu kaasɛ wu bɛɛŋ Yɛlusalɛm, bamii ba mbɛmɛ bamu tu bo sage wu. Bamii banɛ le ba gɛ̀ lɛme gɛh lɛ ba kɛme ki ba chvuu muh wu le gɛ muh Bajuu gɛ yeh, fɛ mwɛdɛ nyu muh wu Nyo.
Bo tu bo sage wu bo biide lɛ, “Wo chi jiɛnyi nɛɛ fɛ wo la jigɛ a bamii ba baaŋ binshushu le, wo ka jii mwɛɛ bena bo?”
Bita mo wu najɛ chuule fiɛɛ fichii fì gɛ̀ kooshɛ, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,
“Ŋgɛ mbee a kilaantɛŋ kì Joba le mbuune, fiɛɛ njɛ kifilɛ ja fi to fɛ mɛne. N'yɛŋ a fiɛɛ fiyu le, fiɛɛ fimi shiide fɛwe njɛ kikwɛɛ ki nju, ba jiji yi abu le ana. Fi shii, fi lɛɛŋ a mɛ jii.
Ndoo mbijɛ yo, n'yɛŋ nyáŋ le chikfuu le chikfuu le, yimi nyume yi fɛ yeh le, yimi nyume yi nchvuuŋ bɛ yì loone, mo munyii mù fuune we.
Nja n'yu jɛ jɛmɛ mɛne lɛ,

content.text: ‘Bita, ja we wo yuuyɛ wo ji.’

content: Nchvuu lɛ, ‘Tada, gɛ taŋlo mɛ moŋ gɛ. Gɛ fiɛɛ fì nchɛ kɛnɛ fi yuude gɛ, gɛ lee wa a mɛ mu gɛ.’
Jɛ yiyu ka yi jɛmɛ we lɛ,

content.text: ‘Keefɛ wo nyîɛŋse fiɛɛ fì Nyo le wu fɛ wa fi yuude gɛ.’

content: Fi kooshɛ noo bu kiŋgane kintɛde bo mo bo kaasɛ bo chii fiɛɛ fiyu fichii fi bɛɛŋ we.
Gɛh segeyu, bamii batɛde fɛsɛ fɛ yeh yì ŋgɛ̀ nchee fo, bo ja Kasalia, ba tuŋ lɛ bo to bo tɛɛŋ mɛ.
Kiyo ki Yuude jɛmɛ mɛne lɛ keefɛ mɛ nyiɛŋse ki ŋgɛɛŋ besa bamii bayu gɛ. Booŋ ba bwee besa ba Joba ba bvusoo banɛ bi mɛne, besa bo bachii gɛɛŋ be lee a muh wuyu yeh.
No bee lese, wu sɛɛŋ bee no wu gɛ̀ yɛŋ nchɛndaa wu Nyo le a wu yeh, wu jɛmɛ lɛ ntuŋ muh Joba wu gɛɛŋ wu tɛɛŋ muh mu wù ba tɛŋe lɛ Samoŋ Bita.
Muh wɛɛ lé wu gê wu tô bɛ saaka wu bamii bachii ba le a wu yeh lé bo gê bo bônɛ yu.
Ndoo ŋkɛ lɛ njɛme, Kiyo ki Yuude ja ki shii yi bamii bayu le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no ki gɛ̀ to yi ye yese besabɛŋ le fɛŋkɛɛ.
N'yɛŋ noo, mɛ mo ŋkwajɛ fiɛɛ fì Tada gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: ‘Joŋ gɛ leese bamii a joo, geenɛ, Nyo lé wu gê wu lêesɛ bɛŋ nyu yi Kiyo ki Yuude le.’

content: No Nyo gɛ̀ nya bamii bayu bɛ nnya nyu gɛh yì wu gɛ̀ nya besabɛŋ le sege besabɛŋ gɛ̀ leesɛ muntele yi Tada Jiso Kletu le, nle yɛɛŋ wù nfaŋ fiɛɛ fì gee Nyo?”

Bamii bayu yu no Bita jɛme noo, bo gɛ ka bo sage wu gɛ. Bo mo bo ja bo tumɛ nyu maŋkuŋ ma Nyo bo duu lɛ, “Finɛ le noo, tu Nyo le wu nya wa tɛ je bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ, lɛ bo kusɛ muntele muboo ki bo kɛme kinche kì kage gɛ.”
Bamii ba duude ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ leesɛ muntele yi Tada Jiso le Antiok
Bamii ba gɛ̀ saaŋe no ŋgɛ kɛ, sege ba gɛ̀ yuuyɛ Tifiŋ bo gɛɛŋ manjuu le manjuu le, bo gɛɛŋ bo bu Fonishia, bamu gɛɛŋ Sablu, bamu Antiok. No bo gɛnɛ noo, bo tu bo feeji jɛ yi Nyo nyu gɛh Bajuu le maa.
Geenɛ, bamii ba mbɛmɛ bamu ba gɛ̀ ja Sablu bɛ Sɛliŋ, bo gɛɛŋ Antiok bo tu bo feeji tɛ saaka wù joŋe wù kune Tada Jiso fɛ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu le gɛ.
Yi bvuŋga bvu Tada Nyo le, bo ge bamii ba duude leesɛ muntele yi Tada Jiso le, bo kusɛ bo tu bɛ wu.
Saaka wuyu wunɛ lee bintuŋ bi kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ le Yɛlusalɛm. Bo mo bo tuŋ Banaba Antiok ayu.
Wu gɛɛŋ wu bu yo, wu yɛŋ no Nyo le wu dunyɛ fitele fì joŋe fɛ bo le, wu yu njoŋ, wu mo wu teefe bo no bo bîi Tada le bɛ muntele muboo munchii.
Banaba wunɛ gɛ̀ bee muh wù joŋe, wu yisɛ bɛ Kiyo ki Yuude wu ka kɛme mbɛmɛ chuule. Noo, wu ge bamii ba duude ba yo lee muntele yi Tada le.
Banaba gɛ̀ ja wu gɛɛŋ Tasu ki wu gôoŋ Sol.

Wu gɛ̀ gooŋ wu yɛŋ wu le, wu jo wu bɛ wu tu jiŋ Antiok. Bɛ wu tu bo nyume yo yi kiluŋ le kichile bɛ kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ, bo yɛyi bamii ba duude. Le Antiok ayu a ba gɛ̀ kɛ ba tɛŋe ŋgoo yi bamii ba mbɛmɛ lɛ bamii ba Kletu.
Lɛ nyume gɛh kife kiyu le, bamii bamu ba gɛ̀ sɛŋe mwɛɛ mù bo yuge Nyo jɛme, ja Yɛlusalɛm bo boh bo gɛɛŋ Antiok ayu.

Kiyo ki Yuude ge muh mu bo le wù jee che gɛ̀ bee Agabu ki wu jâ wu lɛɛŋ we, wu tee lɛ jɛŋ yì tɛɛme lé yi gê yi kôo bituŋ bichii. Jɛŋ yiyu gɛ̀ bee yi jiɛnyɛ yi koo kife kì Klawdiu gɛ̀ bee Nfoŋ wu Lum.
Ŋgoo yi bamii ba mbɛmɛ ba Antiok yu noo, bo seesɛ lɛ muh wuchii su bige no wù kɛme, bo fih booŋ ba bwe bo ba le Judia yu.
Bo mo bo su, bo tuŋ Banaba bɛ Sol bɛ bige biyu lɛ bo gɛɛŋ bo nya bachiji kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ le.
